docs.text: Welcome to the official documentation for AxedGaming mods.

docs.title: Scavenging
docs.text:
Scavenging is a lightweight, data-driven loot system for Minecraft modpacks.

Players can search blocks using tools or their bare hands and receive configurable loot based on custom recipes.

Features:

  • Data pack support
  • KubeJS support
  • JEI integration
  • Multiple loot outputs
  • Per-output drop chances
  • Optional tool durability usage
  • Bare hand recipes

Use the navigation menu to access the Scavenging documentation.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Scavenging is a data-driven system that allows players to search blocks for loot.

Recipes define:

  • Which block can be scavenged
  • Which tool is required (optional)
  • Whether the tool takes durability damage
  • Which items can be obtained
  • The chance of obtaining each item

Scavenging is designed for:

  • Modpack creators
  • Datapack creators
  • KubeJS users

docs.title: Features
docs.text:
• Fully datapack driven
  • Fully KubeJS compatible
  • JEI support
  • Multiple outputs per recipe
  • Individual drop chances
  • Optional bare-hand recipes
  • Optional durability consumption

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
A player right-clicks sand using a stone shovel.

The recipe may return:

  • Cobblestone (75%)
  • Flint (25%)
  • Diamond (1%)

Each output is rolled independently.

docs.title: Examples
docs.text: This page contains ready-to-use Scavenging recipe examples.

docs.title: Sand with a Shovel
docs.text:
This recipe requires a stone shovel and has a 25% chance to drop flint.

JSONKubeJSKubeJS JSON 
{
  "type": "scavenging:scavenging",
  "tool": {
    "item": "minecraft:stone_shovel"
  },
  "block": "minecraft:sand",
  "outputs": [
    {
      "item": {
        "id": "minecraft:flint",
        "count": 1
      },
      "chance": 0.25
    }
  ]
}

ServerEvents.recipes(event => {
  event.recipes.scavenging.scavenging(
    'minecraft:sand',
    [
      {
        item: 'minecraft:flint',
        chance: 0.25
      }
    ]
  ).tool('minecraft:stone_shovel')
})

ServerEvents.recipes(event => {
  event.custom({
    type: 'scavenging:scavenging',
    tool: {
      item: 'minecraft:stone_shovel'
    },
    block: 'minecraft:sand',
    outputs: [
      {
        item: {
          id: 'minecraft:flint',
          count: 1
        },
        chance: 0.25
      }
    ]
  })
})

docs.title: Damaging Tool Recipe
docs.text:
This recipe consumes 1 durability from the tool every time it is executed.

JSONKubeJSKubeJS JSON 
{
  "type": "scavenging:scavenging",
  "tool": {
    "item": "minecraft:iron_shovel"
  },
  "damage_tool": true,
  "block": "minecraft:sand",
  "outputs": [
    {
      "item": {
        "id": "minecraft:clay_ball",
        "count": 2
      },
      "chance": 0.4
    }
  ]
}

ServerEvents.recipes(event => {
  event.recipes.scavenging.scavenging(
    'minecraft:sand',
    [
      {
        item: Item.of('minecraft:clay_ball', 2),
        chance: 0.4
      }
    ]
  ).tool('minecraft:iron_shovel').damageTool(true)
})

ServerEvents.recipes(event => {
  event.custom({
    type: 'scavenging:scavenging',
    tool: {
      item: 'minecraft:iron_shovel'
    },
    damage_tool: true,
    block: 'minecraft:sand',
    outputs: [
      {
        item: {
          id: 'minecraft:clay_ball',
          count: 2
        },
        chance: 0.4
      }
    ]
  })
})

docs.title: FAQ
Getting Started
docs.text:
Scavenging recipes are loaded through Minecraft datapacks.

Recipes are stored in:

data/<namespace>/recipe/

Example:

data/scavenging/recipe/sand_scavenging.json

docs.title: Basic Recipe
docs.text:
{
  "type": "scavenging:scavenging",
  "tool": {
    "item": "minecraft:stone_shovel"
  },
  "damage_tool": true,
  "block": "minecraft:sand",
  "outputs": [
    {
      "item": {
        "id": "minecraft:cobblestone",
        "count": 1
      },
      "chance": 0.75
    }
  ]
}

When the player right-clicks a sand block with a stone shovel, the recipe is executed.

The output has a 75% chance to drop.
